subject: Fix getKeysUsingKeySpecs keynum case ignoring keystep when calc the last key (#3197)
reason: The fix changes getKeysUsingKeySpecs's last-key formula from first+numkeys-1 to first+(numkeys-1)*step, which differs only when a KEYNUM key spec has keystep > 1. Every built-in command with a KEYNUM spec (EVAL/EVALSHA/FCALL families, ZUNION/ZINTER/ZDIFF/ZINTERCARD, SINTERCARD, LMPOP/BLMPOP, ZMPOP/BZMPOP) declares keystep = 1 (all .fk.keynum={0,1,1} in commands.def), so key extraction, COMMAND GETKEYS, ACL key checks and cluster routing are identical on both builds for every reachable command. The changed path is reachable only by a module command registering a KEYNUM spec with keystep > 1 via
